newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish Centrostal to enter bourse Feb or March 97.
newsitem.headline: Polish Centrostal to enter bourse Feb or March 97.

text.p: Polish steel products trader Centrostal SA, whose initial public offering of one million shares starts on December 9, plans a bourse entry for late February or early March 1997, the firm's finance director said.
"If there are no delays we see our bourse entry in late February or early March," Jerzy Ilkiewicz told Reuters.
He said the firm preferred a main-market listing but that it was not yet clear if after the issue the shareholder structure would be too concentrated for the main floor.
Centrostal's main shareholders are Stalexport, with 53.8 percent, and brokerage house Beskidzki Dom Maklerski SA (BDM), with 13.6 percent. BDM is 20-percent owned by Stalexport.
Centrostal expects its net profit to rise to two million zlotys in 1996 from last year's 1.8 million zlotys.
It sees sales up to 103.9 million zlotys from last year's 78.6 million zlotys.
